reason: Conversation 1 made real diagnostic progress: it checked pump noise, had her unplug and safely inspect the drain hose (finding the squashed hose, matching the hidden truth), retested, and then correctly concluded a likely blocked pump filter without recommending a part. Its weaknesses are a slightly dismissive opening about her 'preference' and a thin final step that jumps to an engineer rather than suggesting the controlled small-tube drain or having a family member clean the filter. Conversation 2 never got to the hose check at all, repeated the same 'Drain & Spin' question verbatim three times after she said she couldn't tell, and left her with water in the drum and no actionable next step, so despite respecting her refusal it failed on efficiency and diagnosis.
